summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2003-1 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report that Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator, furnished a preliminary remarketing memorandum for the Class A-5C Reset Rate Notes to qualified institutional buyers. The exhibit discloses pool statistics as of July 31, 2026, describing FFELP-guaranteed consolidation loans originally from Student Loan Marketing Association. This is a routine ABS remarketing disclosure, not a corporate special situation. No transaction terms, prices, or strategic actions are involved. Watch for completion of the note remarketing; risk-arbitrage is not applicable.
